content-engine-portfolio/.title: Auto-publishing content engine
content-engine-portfolio/.desc: A back office and a 10-step pipeline that picks topics, writes, fact-checks, grades and makes images, then publishes 5 grade-A articles a day. It checks itself every 5 minutes and alerts in Telegram.

tans-tools-devpanel-portfolio/.title: Tan’s Tools · DEV panel
tans-tools-devpanel-portfolio/.desc: A panel beside the IDE that switches pages and edge cases of the real app in one click, swaps themes for review, and sends spots marked on the real page to Claude's terminal with numbered screenshots.

android-box-portfolio/.title: TX98 TV Box — from malware to a home screen we use
android-box-portfolio/.desc: Removed a residential proxy over ADB without root, then designed a new Thai launcher that opens the Xiaomi camera stream full screen on the TV, plus Premier League data built for the remote.

tools-portfolio/.title: Tan's Tools — offline document tools, no websites needed
tools-portfolio/.desc: My own PDF tools (Thai page numbers, watermarks, image compression, unlocking PDFs before sending them to AI) and 12 open-source apps from ArtCraft, all inside Tan's Tasks. No sign-up, no uploads.

shotdeck-box-portfolio/.title: shotdeck-box — a used laptop that cuts and posts clips overnight
shotdeck-box-portfolio/.desc: A 2017 laptop left on at home voices, renders, checks and posts short clips to 5 platforms on a schedule. It repairs itself in 3 layers and takes orders from my phone; 115 clips scheduled in the first 3 weeks.

motion-reel-portfolio/.title: Motion Graphics — hard topics people watch to the end
motion-reel-portfolio/.desc: Short clips cut one technique at a time: document zooms, counting numbers, stacked headlines and 2.5D Thai mural scenes with a moving camera. Built as templates so every episode shares one look.

drive-autosort-portfolio/.title: Drive Auto-Sort — no iCloud, the HDD sorts photos itself
drive-autosort-portfolio/.desc: Drop photos into an Inbox and the Mac sorts them into slips, screenshots, dogs, cats, plants or sky with the on-device Vision framework. Tailscale lets an iPhone send to the home HDD from anywhere.

jira-tasks-portfolio/.title: Tan's Tasks — Jira to today's schedule in one click
jira-tasks-portfolio/.desc: One file you double-click to run: pull Jira tickets, pick today's work, set times and add them to Google Calendar, with Notion-style notes, an AI assistant and a standup draft from one source.

ring-bot-billing-portfolio/.title: Nong Kring — a bot that bills the household electricity
ring-bot-billing-portfolio/.desc: The electricity bill arrives by email, the amount lands in a sheet as an auditable formula, and a bill with a PromptPay QR goes to LINE on schedule, after passing 6 checks every time.

trip-cnx-portfolio/.title: Chiang Mai Trip — a plan my parents in their 60s can read
trip-cnx-portfolio/.desc: A Chiang Mai trip page designed with a 60-year-old reader as the starting constraint: day-by-day plan with a route map, large type, high contrast, pine green and terracotta, and a checklist that remembers what you ticked.
trip-cnx-portfolio/.footer: Case Study — UX for Aging Eyes

club-revamp-portfolio/.title: Premium Club Revamp — rules on what not to do, first
club-revamp-portfolio/.desc: A premium club site revamp where the biggest risk was looking like a template. It started with a list of things to avoid, one OKLCH token file, a contrast checker and a demo-first approach.

shotdeck-portfolio/.title: Shotdeck — AI short videos that don't look AI-made
shotdeck-portfolio/.desc: Product strategy for an AI-produced explainer channel: what makes AI content get scrolled past, then a locked format, visual rules and a cost per clip measured from real tests.

book-screenshot-portfolio/.title: Book Screenshot — book captures → one PDF
book-screenshot-portfolio/.desc: A Chrome extension that captures book pages from what is actually on screen, turns pages itself, checks for duplicates at two levels and builds a PDF in memory. 4 capture modes, no PDF library, no DRM bypass.

live-arduino-portfolio/.title: TanPlanet Live — an ESP32 desk display
live-arduino-portfolio/.desc: A ฿640 3.5" screen and a Mac backend: Thai calendar, lunar phase, weather, investing horoscope, stock portfolio, AI quota and Claude Code status as 12 tappable cards, built with LVGL 9 and a self-generated Thai font.

media-sniffer-portfolio/.title: MP4/M3U8 Sniffer — catch video links → yt-dlp
media-sniffer-portfolio/.desc: A Chrome extension (Manifest V3) that catches media streams on a page, tells HLS master and variant playlists apart, keeps the real headers and builds a yt-dlp command ready to paste.

megacoach-portfolio/.title: MegaCoach — an AI coach for my stock portfolio
megacoach-portfolio/.desc: A personal AI coach for a US stock portfolio, with a LIFF dashboard and DCA/stop/RMF alerts in LINE. Money figures are encrypted zero-knowledge (AES-256-GCM) on the device before reaching the cloud.

team-platform-portfolio/.title: Team Platform — boards, calendar, clients, docs
team-platform-portfolio/.desc: Kanban, calendar, CRM, quotations and expense claims, and AI meeting notes in one place. Automation runs on serverless cron, and it was multi-tenant (org_id + RLS) from the first migration.

saju-kaaju-portfolio/.title: Saju Kaaju — Korean Saju Reading
saju-kaaju-portfolio/.desc: A Thai-language Korean Saju (사주팔자) web app that separates calculating (a Python engine with KASI astronomical data) from telling (Uncle Pae, an AI character who reads the chart as a mirror, not a verdict).

linen-lookbook-portfolio/.title: Pick a look, order via LINE
linen-lookbook-portfolio/.desc: A catalog and lookbook with no cart and no checkout. Customers pick a color and size, then a deep link opens LINE with the message pre-filled. The brand manages products itself in Payload CMS.

hospital-site-portfolio/.title: Hospital site with a hiring system
hospital-site-portfolio/.desc: A bilingual full-stack site (Next.js + Sanity CMS) for a specialty hospital before opening, with an applicant tracking system that renders Thai application PDFs in headless Chrome and emails them to HR.

ugc-extension-portfolio/.title: UGC Extension — UGC video prompt builder
ugc-extension-portfolio/.desc: A Chrome extension (MV3 Side Panel) with a CMS back office: scrape a product, build the system prompt (BYOK LLM), then drive an AI video site with no public API through CDP.

model-switcher-portfolio/.title: Model Shift — switch Claude Code models like a gear stick
model-switcher-portfolio/.desc: A VS Code / Cursor extension that turns /model into an H-pattern gear stick panel. Shift gears to switch models, with real state synced from the transcript and a switch for task-done sounds.

ugc-studio-portfolio/.title: UGC Studio — an AI director for UGC videos
ugc-studio-portfolio/.desc: Vertical UGC sales videos from product photos and a short brief. AI plans shots, generates footage, voices it in Thai with timestamps, and Remotion pops keywords in time with the speech.

avatar-commerce-portfolio/.type: AI Avatar Live Platform · Web App
avatar-commerce-portfolio/.title: AI Avatar Live Commerce Platform

live-insights-portfolio/.title: A coach for live sellers
live-insights-portfolio/.desc: An Electron app with a built-in browser that reads the host's mood and attention with on-device Python ML. Only derived signals go to an encrypted cloud, with full PDPA compliance.

live-commerce-portfolio/.title: Live Commerce Site — Vue 3 + Vite SSG
live-commerce-portfolio/.desc: The marketing site for an AI Avatar live platform (3 products), migrated from an HTML/jQuery template to Vue 3 + Vite SSG: static prerendering, interactive components, served with Docker + nginx.

live-rebroadcast-portfolio/.title: Re-broadcast Control Room
live-rebroadcast-portfolio/.desc: An Electron app that packs a Go backend, an ffmpeg streaming engine and a React SPA into one. It streams over RTMP with overlays, live chat and pinned products, all on the seller's machine.

host-monitor-portfolio/.title: Live Commerce Host Monitor
host-monitor-portfolio/.desc: An R&D prototype that chains 4 models (MTCNN → FaceNet → ViT/FER → MediaPipe) into a real-time pipeline reading a live host's emotion and engagement, running fully on the machine.

chatbot-farm-portfolio/.title: Luk Jiab · Chicken Farm Bot
chatbot-farm-portfolio/.desc: A LINE chatbot for a pullet farm that reminds workers in a LINE group 3 times a day, takes reports through LIFF and saves them to Google Sheets. The full loop was built in one session.

hangun-portfolio/.title: HanGun — Trip Bill Splitter
hangun-portfolio/.desc: Split trip bills with friends: scan a QR to join, add expenses, and see who pays whom, with debts netted out so the group makes as few transfers as possible.

Internal-Tools-Portfolio/.title: Digital OS for a group of companies
Internal-Tools-Portfolio/.desc: An internal portal that brings 8 departments into one system for the Real Factory group, with UX/UI designed so every team can actually use it.

Legal-AI/.title: Legal AI
Legal-AI/.desc: Research across 84K+ sections of Thai law with RAG + GPT-4o. Ask in plain language and get answers with Citation Cards that point to the actual sections.
Legal-AI/.footer: AI Web App — Legal Tech POC

design-inspector-for-claude-portfolio/.title: Design Inspector for Claude

claude-skills-registry/.title: Claude Code Skills Registry
claude-skills-registry/.desc: Every skill, plugin and MCP server installed in Claude Code, in one source of truth with search, filters and highlights.

flower-shop-portfolio/.title: Design your own bouquet online
flower-shop-portfolio/.desc: UI/UX for an online flower shop: a Buyer Portal for ordering custom bouquets and a Seller Portal dashboard for managing the shop, orders and stock.

mood-calendar-portfolio/.title: Mood Calendar That Gets You

agri-ecommerce-portfolio/.title: Farmers selling direct to buyers
